Mary - Album 1: Bloodlines

Wraith or Wrong

"Wraith or wrong, here we go again"

Musical direction: bright daytime 6_66 skate-punk; sunny, fast, jangly guitars with handclaps / bouncing keys, with a dreamy string lift when Mary realizes she is standing in front of Linda.

[Intro — campus crowd / pages / distant chatter]

Twenty-eight.

Count them.

Twenty-eight.

Every single one.

And yes, I brought all of them.

No, I do not need help.

…

I may need help.

[Verse 1]
Line wraps halfway down the courtyard
Past the library front stair
Everybody came for Linda
Apparently the whole town cares

She writes hauntings, rites and legends
Cryptids, curses, things unseen
Twenty-eight books on my bookshelf
Twenty-eight now crushing me

One beneath my elbow slipping
Three are balanced on my hip
If I die before she signs them
Please make sure she signs the crypt

I’ve read footnotes
I’ve read indexes
Corrections printed years apart

This is not obsession

This is scholarship

With commitment

And upper-body strain

[Pre-Chorus]
One step forward
Hold the stack

Someone bumps me from the back—

I turn around—

WHAM

Books everywhere.

…

You.

[Chorus]
Wraith or wrong
Here we go again
Of all the people in this line
It had to be my friend—

Wait

Not friend.

Definitely not friend.

Wraith or wrong
Pick them off the ground
If one page bends
I swear to every ghost in town—

“Hm.”

What?

“Nothing.”

Why are you looking at my books like that?

[Verse 2]
Hansel kneels and starts collecting
Far too slowly for my taste

Checks each cover
Checks the printing
Wearing that insufferable face

“What?”

“Interesting.”

No.

Don’t say interesting.

“You have all of Linda’s books?”

Obviously.

He starts counting.

One through seven
Twelve through twenty
Twenty-eight—

Then stops.

“You’re missing one.”

…

Excuse me?

“Her first.”

No, I’m not.

“You are.”

I have twenty-eight.

“Yes.”

Twenty-eight.

“Yes.”

All of them.

“No.”

…

I remembered why I hate you.

[Pre-Chorus]
He hands one back
Then tilts his head

“You’ve never read The Wraith Way?”

…

The what?

And suddenly my whole collection
Feels personally betrayed

[Chorus]
Wraith or wrong
How could I miss one?
First editions, later printings
Every damned revised one

Wraith or wrong
Twenty-eight in hand
And Mister Walking Encyclopedia
Smirks because he can

“You really didn’t know?”

Stop enjoying this.

“I’m not.”

You are visibly enjoying this.

“A little.”

[Instrumental — bright skate-punk / keys / handclaps]

[Spoken]

Where did you even find it?

“Linda gave me one.”

…

Linda.

Gave.

You.

One.

“Yeah.”

…

I hate you again.

[Verse 3]
He says, “I can ask her for you.”

What?

“I’ll ask if she has another.”

Why?

…

“Because you want it?”

That is not an answer.

“It feels like one.”

Why are you helping me?

“Sorry.”

…

No, wait—

I mean—

Yes.

Maybe.

Obviously.

But—

Hansel!

Too late

He grabs my wrist
And starts straight through the line

[Build — drums racing / Mary protesting underneath]

You cannot just—

Apparently you can

People are staring

Hansel!

Put me down—

I am walking!

That is worse!

Where are we going?!

“To Linda.”

I KNOW THAT PART!

[Music shifts — lighter keys / strings enter]

And then she looks up.

Linda.

Actual Linda.

Not dust-jacket Linda.

Not tiny-author-photo Linda.

Linda.

[Verse 4 — half-time]
“Hansel!”

“Been a while.”

They know each other.

Of course they know each other.

Why wouldn’t my irritating rich stranger
Know my favorite living author?

She smiles at him
Then looks at me

“And is this your latest one?”

…

What?

Hansel laughs.

“No.”

Then turns—

“Linda, this is—”

…

He stops.

Looks at me.

…

“Wait.”

…

“I don’t know your name.”

[Music drops]

…

You dragged me through an entire line
and you don’t know my name?

“Well, you never told me.”

You never asked!

“I’m asking now.”

…

Linda is staring at me.

Linda.

Is.

Staring.

At.

Me.

[Final Chorus — key lift / layered harmonies]
Wraith or wrong
Maybe I misjudged him
Maybe only slightly
Don’t get carried away

Wraith or wrong
Maybe he’s still awful
But he knows Linda personally
So fine—

He gets one point today

Twenty-eight books
One missing story
One impossible autograph away

And somewhere between irritation
And the best surprise all day—

Someone says—

“Hello?”

[Outro — soft keys / tiny string flourish]

Linda.

To me.

“Hello?”

…

Oh.

Uh—

…

Mary.

“My name is Mary.”

[CUT]

TITLE NOTE — STRUCTURAL / FORESHADOWING:
Surface title function: “Wraith or Wrong” plays on “right or wrong” while the scene revolves around Mary and Hansel repeatedly testing who is correct.
Embedded monster echo: WRAITH is deliberately hidden in the title architecture. This does NOT establish objective wraith lore or an in-story supernatural reveal by itself.
